def cells(frame, ch):
    out=[]
    for r,row in enumerate(frame.ascii.split('\n')):

    return out
def bbox(cs):
    rs=[r for r,_ in cs]; cs2=[c for _,c in cs]
    return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs2),max(cs2))

print("black before",b0,"after",b1,"d",(b1[2]-b0[2],b1[0]-b0[0]))
print({k:last_action_result[k] for k in ('board_changed','no_impact','level_completed')})

def cells(frame, ch):
    out=[]
    for r,row in enumerate(frame.ascii.split('\n')):
        for c in range(len(row)):
            if row[c]==ch and not (r==63 or c==63): out.append((r,c))
    return out
def bbox(cs):
    rs=[r for r,_ in cs]; cs2=[c for _,c in cs]
    return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs2),max(cs2))
